title: The Week in Hype (Sat 21 Nov 2026), drops you can buy in India with ₹ prices: Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Not Nice List' (IF4396-001) on sale at Superkicks today, ₹19,295, UK 7-11 all available at 08:05-08:14 IST (its 'Startdate__21 November 2026 00:01' tag, seen 12 and 14 Nov, is gone); Nike US launch 21 Nov 2026 15:00 UTC (SNKRS), $215 (about ₹20,090 at ₹93.44/$, the rupee's 18 Nov close, the latest found; before US sales tax), so Superkicks' ₹19,295 is below the converted US price; heel tab hides a 'Not Nice' message (Nike, Sneaker Files). Kids' Jordan 3 Retro 'Santa' at Superkicks since 20 Nov evening: TD (DM0968-601) ₹5,695, UK 7.5/8.5/9.5; PS (DM0966-601) ₹6,695, UK 13/1/2; University Red upper, gilded Jumpman on the heel; Nike US kids' release 21 Nov 15:00 UTC (Little Kids' $95, Big Kids' $155); House of Heat lists GS 'Santa' for 21 Nov. adidas Originals Tokyo Ballerina Fruition (with Taipei label Fruition per Highsnobiety; suede upper): ₹9,999 at Superkicks (KI7873 Brown/Gum, LB8173; listed 19 Nov; women's UK 3-7) and VegNonVeg (both colourways ₹9,999). Nike Air Force 1 Low Retro Camo (IV4885-901, IV4885-900): ₹11,995 at Superkicks, listed 18 Nov, UK 6-12; Nike.com US release 4 Nov, $125 (Sneaker Bar Detroit), pixel camo over the upper incl. Swooshes. Complex's 17 Nov release guide led with One Block Down x Nike Air Max 95 Lux and Corteiz x Nike Shox R4; neither is in Superkicks' catalogue or VegNonVeg search (checked 08:16 IST).
